修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。

5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；禁止直接修改 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象/数组及其子对象，例如 selectedAsset.decision = value、note.resolved = true、nodes.push(node)、edges.splice(...)、node.status = status；必须用 map、filter、concat、Object.assign({}, ...) 或对象展开创建新的对象/数组，再通过 this.data.set('assets', nextAssets)、this.data.set('nodes', nextNodes) 等方式写回根字段；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。

Vue 生命周期必须完整迁移：created 中的 prop 派生状态初始化放入 inited，mounted 中的初始方法调用和副作用放入 attached，beforeDestroy/destroyed 中的定时器或监听清理放入 disposed；不能只保留空钩子或只保留钩子名称。依赖 prop 的 data 不得在 initData() 中使用 this.propName 初始化，必须先返回稳定占位值，再在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取、复制并通过 this.data.set(...) 写入。Vue watch: {...} 不会被 San 自动注册，必须在 inited/attached 中使用 this.watch('field', handler)。

gap: 8px; }\r\n.rule-builder button { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 4px; background: #334155; color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }\r\n.rule-builder button.secondary, .group-toolbar button, .rule-row button { background: #ffffff; color: #334155; border-color: #94a3b8; }\r\n.builder-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin: 20px 0; }\r\n.builder-stats article { padding: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #0f766e; }\r\n.builder-workspace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; min-height: 310px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; background: #ffffff; }\r\n.group-sidebar { padding: 12px; border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0; margin-bottom: 6px; background: #ffffff !important; color: #334155 !important; border-color: #cbd5e1 !important; text-align: left; }\r\n.group-tab.active { border-color: #0f766e !important; background: #ccfbf1 !important; border: 1px solid #94a3b8; }\r\n.rule-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 16px 0; }\r\n.rule-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 1fr 1fr auto; gap: 7px; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }\r\n.rule-row.invalid { border-color: #fca5a5; background: #fff1f2; }\r\n.rule-index { display: grid; place-items: center; color: #64748b; }\r\n.add-rule { background: #0f766e !important; border-color: #0f766e !important; }\r\n.empty-editor { display: grid; place-items: center; color: #94a3b8; }\r\n.expression-preview { margin-top: 16px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; background: #ecfdf5; }\r\n.expression-preview > div { display: flex; <template>
<main class="rule-builder">
    <header class="builder-header">
        <div>
            <span class="eyebrow">自动化配置</span>
            <h1>{{title}}</h1>
            <p>将业务条件组合为可执行规则</p>
        </div>
        <div class="header-actions">
            <button type="button" class="secondary" on-click="togglePreview">{{previewOpen ? '关闭预览' : '预览表达式'}}</button>
            <button type="button" on-click="save" disabled="{{readonly || invalidRuleCount > 0}}">保存规则</button>
        </div>
    </header>
    <section class="builder-stats">
        <article>
            <span>条件组</span>
            <strong>{{groups.length}}</strong>
        </article>
        <article>
            <span>规则数</span>
            <strong>{{ruleCount}}</strong>
        </article>
        <article class="{{invalidRuleCount ? 'warning' : ''}}">
            <span>待修正</span>
            <strong>{{invalidRuleCount}}</strong>
        </article>
    </section>
    <section class="builder-workspace">
        <aside class="group-sidebar">
            <div class="sidebar-title">
                <strong>条件组</strong>
                <button type="button" on-click="addGroup" disabled="{{readonly}}">+</button>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="group-tab" s-for="group in groups trackby group.id" class="{{selectedGroupId === group.id ? 'active' : ''}}" on-click="selectGroup(group.id)">
                <span>{{group.name}}</span>
                <small>{{group.rules.length}} 条</small>
            </button>
        </aside>
        <div class="group-editor" s-if="selectedGroup">
            <div class="group-toolbar">
                <input type="text" on-input="renameGroup($event.target.value)" value="{= selectedGroup.name =}" disabled="{{readonly}}" />
                <select on-change="changeMode($event.target.value)" value="{= selectedGroup.mode =}" disabled="{{readonly}}">
                    <option value="all">满足全部</option>
                    <option value="any">满足任一</option>
                </select>
                <button type="button" on-click="removeGroup(selectedGroup.id)" disabled="{{readonly || groups.length === 1}}">删除组</button>
            </div>
            <div class="rule-list">
                <article class="rule-row" s-for="rule in selectedGroup.rules trackby rule.id" class="{{!rule.value ? 'invalid' : ''}}">
                    <span class="rule-index">{{index + 1}}</span>
                    <select on-change="updateRule(rule.id, 'field', $event.target.value)" value="{= rule.field =}" disabled="{{readonly}}">
                        <option s-for="field in availableFields trackby field.key" value="{= field.key =}">{{field.label}}</option>
                    </select>
                    <select on-change="updateRule(rule.id, 'operator', $event.target.value)" value="{= rule.operator =}" disabled="{{readonly}}">
                        <option value="equals">等于</option>
                        <option value="contains">包含</option>
                        <option value="greater">大于</option>
                    </select>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="比较值" on-input="updateRule(rule.id, 'value', $event.target.value)" value="{= rule.value =}" disabled="{{readonly}}" />
                    <button type="button" on-click="removeRule(rule.id)" disabled="{{readonly}}">移除</button>
                </article>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="add-rule" on-click="addRule" disabled="{{readonly}}">添加条件</button>
        </div>
        <div class="empty-editor" s-else>请选择条件组</div>
    </section>
    <section class="expression-preview" s-if="previewOpen">
        <div>
            <strong>逻辑表达式</strong>
            <button type="button" on-click="validate">重新校验</button>
        </div>
        <code>{{expression}}</code>
        <ul s-if="errors.length">
            <li s-for="error in errors trackby error">{{error}}</li>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'RuleBuilder',

    components: {},

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        availableFields: DataTypes.array,
        initialGroups: DataTypes.array,
        readonly: DataTypes.bool
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            title: '客户分群规则',
            availableFields: [
                { key: 'region', label: '地区' },
                { key: 'score', label: '活跃分' },
                { key: 'tag', label: '标签' }
            ],
            initialGroups: [
                { id: 1, name: '基础条件', mode: 'all', rules: [{ id: 1, field: 'region', operator: 'equals', value: '西南' }] },
                { id: 2, name: '行为条件', mode: 'any', rules: [{ id: 2, field: 'score', operator: 'greater', value: '80' }] }
            ],
            readonly: false,
            groups: [],
            selectedGroupId: 0,
            previewOpen: false,
            errors: [],
            nextGroupId: 3,
            nextRuleId: 3,
            savedAt: '',
            autosaveTimer: null,
            draftName: '',
            testPayload: {}
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups');
        this.data.set('groups', initialGroups);
        const groupsLen = initialGroups.length;
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', groupsLen ? initialGroups[0].id : 0);
    },

    attached() {
        this.validate();
        this.scheduleAutosave();
    },

    disposed() {
        const autosaveTimer = this.data.get('autosaveTimer');
        if (autosaveTimer) {
            clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
        }
    },

    computed: {
        selectedGroup() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            const selectedGroupId = this.data.get('selectedGroupId');
            return groups.find(group => group.id === selectedGroupId) || null;
        },

        ruleCount() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.rules.length, 0);
        },

        invalidRuleCount() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.rules.filter(rule => !String(rule.value).trim()).length, 0);
        },

        expression() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.map(group => {
                const joiner = group.mode === 'all' ? ' AND ' : ' OR ';
                return `(${group.rules.map(rule => `${rule.field} ${rule.operator} "${rule.value}"`).join(joiner)})`;
            }).join(' AND ');
        }
    },

    selectGroup(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', id);
    },

    addGroup() {
        const nextGroupId = this.data.get('nextGroupId');
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const group = {
            id: nextGroupId,
            name: `条件组 ${groups.length + 1}`,
            mode: 'all',
            rules: []
        };
        this.data.set('groups', [...groups, group]);
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', group.id);
        this.data.set('nextGroupId', nextGroupId + 1);
        this.changed();
    },

    removeGroup(id) {
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const filteredGroups = groups.filter(group => group.id !== id);
        this.data.set('groups', filteredGroups);
        const newSelectedId = filteredGroups.length ? filteredGroups[0].id : 0;
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', newSelectedId);
        this.changed();
    },

    renameGroup(value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.name = value;
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    changeMode(value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.mode = value;
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    addRule() {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        const nextRuleId = this.data.get('nextRuleId');
        const availableFields = this.data.get('availableFields');
        if (selectedGroup && availableFields.length > 0) {
            const newRule = {
                id: nextRuleId,
                field: availableFields[0].key,
                operator: 'equals',
                value: ''
            };
            selectedGroup.rules.push(newRule);
            this.data.set('nextRuleId', nextRuleId + 1);
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    removeRule(id) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.rules = selectedGroup.rules.filter(rule => rule.id !== id);
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    updateRule(id, key, value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            const rule = selectedGroup.rules.find(item => item.id === id);
            if (rule) {
                rule[key] = value;
                this.changed();
            }
        }
    },

    validate() {
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const errors = [];
        groups.forEach(group => {
            if (!group.name.trim()) {
                errors.push('条件组名称不能为空');
            }
            group.rules.forEach(rule => {
                if (!String(rule.value).trim()) {
                    errors.push(`${group.name} 存在空比较值`);
                }
            });
        });
        this.data.set('errors', errors);
        return errors.length === 0;
    },

    changed() {
        this.validate();
        this.scheduleAutosave();
    },

    scheduleAutosave() {
        const autosaveTimer = this.data.get('autosaveTimer');
        if (autosaveTimer) {
            clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
        }
        const readonly = this.data.get('readonly');
        if (!readonly) {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => {
                this.data.set('savedAt', '自动保存完成');
            }, 400);
            this.data.set('autosaveTimer', timer);
        }
    },

    save() {
        if (!this.validate()) return;
        const now = new Date();
        const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        this.data.set('savedAt', timeStr);
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const expression = this.data.get('expression');
        this.fire('save', {
            groups: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(groups)),
            expression: expression
        });
    },

    togglePreview() {
        const previewOpen = this.data.get('previewOpen');
        this.data.set('previewOpen', !previewOpen);
    }
});
</script>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'RuleBuilder',

    components: {},

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        availableFields: DataTypes.array,
        initialGroups: DataTypes.array,
        readonly: DataTypes.bool
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            title: '客户分群规则',
            availableFields: [
                { key: 'region', label: '地区' },
                { key: 'score', label: '活跃分' },
                { key: 'tag', label: '标签' }
            ],
            initialGroups: [
                { id: 1, name: '基础条件', mode: 'all', rules: [{ id: 1, field: 'region', operator: 'equals', value: '西南' }] },
                { id: 2, name: '行为条件', mode: 'any', rules: [{ id: 2, field: 'score', operator: 'greater', value: '80' }] }
            ],
            readonly: false,
            groups: [],
            selectedGroupId: 0,
            previewOpen: false,
            errors: [],
            nextGroupId: 3,
            nextRuleId: 3,
            savedAt: '',
            autosaveTimer: null,
            draftName: '',
            testPayload: {}
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups');
        this.data.set('groups', initialGroups);
        const groupsLen = initialGroups.length;
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', groupsLen ? initialGroups[0].id : 0);
    },

    attached() {
        this.validate();
        this.scheduleAutosave();
    },

    disposed() {
        const autosaveTimer = this.data.get('autosaveTimer');
        if (autosaveTimer) {
            clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
        }
    },

    computed: {
        selectedGroup() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            const selectedGroupId = this.data.get('selectedGroupId');
            return groups.find(group => group.id === selectedGroupId) || null;
        },

        ruleCount() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.rules.length, 0);
        },

        invalidRuleCount() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.rules.filter(rule => !String(rule.value).trim()).length, 0);
        },

        expression() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.map(group => {
                const joiner = group.mode === 'all' ? ' AND ' : ' OR ';
                return `(${group.rules.map(rule => `${rule.field} ${rule.operator} "${rule.value}"`).join(joiner)})`;
            }).join(' AND ');
        }
    },

    selectGroup(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', id);
    },

    addGroup() {
        const nextGroupId = this.data.get('nextGroupId');
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const group = {
            id: nextGroupId,
            name: `条件组 ${groups.length + 1}`,
            mode: 'all',
            rules: []
        };
        this.data.set('groups', [...groups, group]);
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', group.id);
        this.data.set('nextGroupId', nextGroupId + 1);
        this.changed();
    },

    removeGroup(id) {
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const filteredGroups = groups.filter(group => group.id !== id);
        this.data.set('groups', filteredGroups);
        const newSelectedId = filteredGroups.length ? filteredGroups[0].id : 0;
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', newSelectedId);
        this.changed();
    },

    renameGroup(value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.name = value;
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    changeMode(value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.mode = value;
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    addRule() {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        const nextRuleId = this.data.get('nextRuleId');
        const availableFields = this.data.get('availableFields');
        if (selectedGroup && availableFields.length > 0) {
            const newRule = {
                id: nextRuleId,
                field: availableFields[0].key,
                operator: 'equals',
                value: ''
            };
            selectedGroup.rules.push(newRule);
            this.data.set('nextRuleId', nextRuleId + 1);
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    removeRule(id) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.rules = selectedGroup.rules.filter(rule => rule.id !== id);
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    updateRule(id, key, value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            const rule = selectedGroup.rules.find(item => item.id === id);
            if (rule) {
                rule[key] = value;
                this.changed();
            }
        }
    },

    validate() {
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const errors = [];
        groups.forEach(group => {
            if (!group.name.trim()) {
                errors.push('条件组名称不能为空');
            }
            group.rules.forEach(rule => {
                if (!String(rule.value).trim()) {
                    errors.push(`${group.name} 存在空比较值`);
                }
            });
        });
        this.data.set('errors', errors);
        return errors.length === 0;
    },

    changed() {
        this.validate();
        this.scheduleAutosave();
    },

    scheduleAutosave() {
        const autosaveTimer = this.data.get('autosaveTimer');
        if (autosaveTimer) {
            clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
        }
        const readonly = this.data.get('readonly');
        if (!readonly) {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => {
                this.data.set('savedAt', '自动保存完成');
            }, 400);
            this.data.set('autosaveTimer', timer);
        }
    },

    save() {
        if (!this.validate()) return;
        const now = new Date();
        const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        this.data.set('savedAt', timeStr);
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const expression = this.data.get('expression');
        this.fire('save', {
            groups: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(groups)),
            expression: expression
        });
    },

    togglePreview() {
        const previewOpen = this.data.get('previewOpen');
        this.data.set('previewOpen', !previewOpen);
    }
});
</script>

你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；禁止直接修改 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象/数组及其子对象，例如 selectedAsset.decision = value、note.resolved = true、nodes.push(node)、edges.splice(...)、node.status = status；必须用 map、filter、concat、Object.assign({}, ...) 或对象展开创建新的对象/数组，再通过 this.data.set('assets', nextAssets)、this.data.set('nodes', nextNodes) 等方式写回根字段；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. Vue 生命周期必须完整迁移：created 中的 prop 派生状态初始化放入 inited，mounted 中的初始方法调用和副作用放入 attached，beforeDestroy/destroyed 中的定时器或监听清理放入 disposed；不能只保留空钩子或只保留钩子名称。依赖 prop 的 data 不得在 initData() 中使用 this.propName 初始化，必须先返回稳定占位值，再在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取、复制并通过 this.data.set(...) 写入。Vue watch: {...} 不会被 San 自动注册，必须在 inited/attached 中使用 this.watch('field', handler)。
12. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
13. 必须保留 Vue template 的 DOM 子节点顺序；元素和文本都存在但顺序改变仍属于错误。特别检查 label/th/footer 中 input 或 checkbox 与相邻文字、百分号、按钮的先后关系，不要用 CSS order 或 flex 排序掩盖模板顺序差异。
14. value、checked、selected、disabled 等关键属性必须逐元素保留 Vue 原表达式，禁止把相邻或同级元素的条件合并进来。例如 select 的 :disabled="previewMode" 必须迁移为 disabled="{{ previewMode }}"，不能误用旁边按钮的 !canConnect || previewMode。
15. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

修复前请按下面清单自检，但最终不要输出清单：
- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。

- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 是否直接修改了 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象、数组、数组元素及嵌套属性，或对其调用 push/splice/sort？所有此类更新是否改为创建新值并通过 this.data.set(...) 写回根字段？
- created/mounted/beforeDestroy/destroyed 是否分别完整迁移到 inited/attached/disposed，且源钩子中的初始化、方法调用、定时器创建和清理均已保留？

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'RuleBuilder',

    components: {},

    dataTypes: {
        title: DataTypes.string,
        availableFields: DataTypes.array,
        initialGroups: DataTypes.array,
        readonly: DataTypes.bool
    },

    initData() {
        return {
            title: '客户分群规则',
            availableFields: [
                { key: 'region', label: '地区' },
                { key: 'score', label: '活跃分' },
                { key: 'tag', label: '标签' }
            ],
            initialGroups: [
                { id: 1, name: '基础条件', mode: 'all', rules: [{ id: 1, field: 'region', operator: 'equals', value: '西南' }] },
                { id: 2, name: '行为条件', mode: 'any', rules: [{ id: 2, field: 'score', operator: 'greater', value: '80' }] }
            ],
            readonly: false,
            groups: [],
            selectedGroupId: 0,
            previewOpen: false,
            errors: [],
            nextGroupId: 3,
            nextRuleId: 3,
            savedAt: '',
            autosaveTimer: null,
            draftName: '',
            testPayload: {}
        };
    },

    inited() {
        const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups');
        this.data.set('groups', initialGroups);
        const groupsLen = initialGroups.length;
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', groupsLen ? initialGroups[0].id : 0);
    },

    attached() {
        this.validate();
        this.scheduleAutosave();
    },

    disposed() {
        const autosaveTimer = this.data.get('autosaveTimer');
        if (autosaveTimer) {
            clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
        }
    },

    computed: {
        selectedGroup() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            const selectedGroupId = this.data.get('selectedGroupId');
            return groups.find(group => group.id === selectedGroupId) || null;
        },

        ruleCount() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.rules.length, 0);
        },

        invalidRuleCount() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.rules.filter(rule => !String(rule.value).trim()).length, 0);
        },

        expression() {
            const groups = this.data.get('groups');
            return groups.map(group => {
                const joiner = group.mode === 'all' ? ' AND ' : ' OR ';
                return `(${group.rules.map(rule => `${rule.field} ${rule.operator} "${rule.value}"`).join(joiner)})`;
            }).join(' AND ');
        }
    },

    selectGroup(id) {
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', id);
    },

    addGroup() {
        const nextGroupId = this.data.get('nextGroupId');
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const group = {
            id: nextGroupId,
            name: `条件组 ${groups.length + 1}`,
            mode: 'all',
            rules: []
        };
        this.data.set('groups', [...groups, group]);
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', group.id);
        this.data.set('nextGroupId', nextGroupId + 1);
        this.changed();
    },

    removeGroup(id) {
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const filteredGroups = groups.filter(group => group.id !== id);
        this.data.set('groups', filteredGroups);
        const newSelectedId = filteredGroups.length ? filteredGroups[0].id : 0;
        this.data.set('selectedGroupId', newSelectedId);
        this.changed();
    },

    renameGroup(value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.name = value;
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    changeMode(value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.mode = value;
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    addRule() {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        const nextRuleId = this.data.get('nextRuleId');
        const availableFields = this.data.get('availableFields');
        if (selectedGroup && availableFields.length > 0) {
            const newRule = {
                id: nextRuleId,
                field: availableFields[0].key,
                operator: 'equals',
                value: ''
            };
            selectedGroup.rules.push(newRule);
            this.data.set('nextRuleId', nextRuleId + 1);
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    removeRule(id) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            selectedGroup.rules = selectedGroup.rules.filter(rule => rule.id !== id);
            this.changed();
        }
    },

    updateRule(id, key, value) {
        const selectedGroup = this.data.get('selectedGroup');
        if (selectedGroup) {
            const rule = selectedGroup.rules.find(item => item.id === id);
            if (rule) {
                rule[key] = value;
                this.changed();
            }
        }
    },

    validate() {
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const errors = [];
        groups.forEach(group => {
            if (!group.name.trim()) {
                errors.push('条件组名称不能为空');
            }
            group.rules.forEach(rule => {
                if (!String(rule.value).trim()) {
                    errors.push(`${group.name} 存在空比较值`);
                }
            });
        });
        this.data.set('errors', errors);
        return errors.length === 0;
    },

    changed() {
        this.validate();
        this.scheduleAutosave();
    },

    scheduleAutosave() {
        const autosaveTimer = this.data.get('autosaveTimer');
        if (autosaveTimer) {
            clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
        }
        const readonly = this.data.get('readonly');
        if (!readonly) {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => {
                this.data.set('savedAt', '自动保存完成');
            }, 400);
            this.data.set('autosaveTimer', timer);
        }
    },

    save() {
        if (!this.validate()) return;
        const now = new Date();
        const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        this.data.set('savedAt', timeStr);
        const groups = this.data.get('groups');
        const expression = this.data.get('expression');
        this.fire('save', {
            groups: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(groups)),
            expression: expression
        });
    },

    togglePreview() {
        const previewOpen = this.data.get('previewOpen');
        this.data.set('previewOpen', !previewOpen);
    }
});
</script>
